fullScope: All 54672 completed trades: independently aggregated 30m candles, Wilder ATR from per-candidate warmup, previous N highs excluding signal, tick breakout, next-open entry, rounded 2ATR initial stop, risk/exposure/quantity/minimum notional, signed carried-position funding at minute mark open, fees, gross/net PnL, initial R, final cash and final daily equity. Independently known raw exits/slippage checked for 29952 trades.
stagedScope: Only the 108 listed representative trades reconstruct every minute of staged management: old-stop priority, post-entry MFE, full-30m close-R stage latches, accrued funding in cost-covering BE, current ATR3 monotone trail and crossed-protection next-open intent. First exit time/reason/fill must match. Not full-universe reconstruction of trailing/BE exits.
sampleSelection: First occurrence per symbol/candidate/exit reason in lexicographically sorted window-file order. Mechanism coverage only; not random statistical sampling.
limits: Account rows include stress reruns and are not independent strategy samples.
Does not recompute all minute daily-loss triggers, all no-trade/rejection decisions, or evaluation ratios.
No new orders, strategy search, plan changes, or counterfactual execution are performed.
